text:
maya: heads up — PR gating for model-onboard has been flapping this morning, seen ~6 false negatives on GH Actions self-hosted runners :grimacing:
sam: ugh, saw those. failing on the quantized smoke step, but passes locally for me with same docker image
jt: logs show `runner-exec` hitting connection timeouts to the cache service; looks like concurrent job storming
maya: exact error snippet: `ERROR: failed to download cache artifact: connection reset by peer`
maya: proposal: add a lightweight `eval-smoke` GH Action that runs a tiny quantized end-to-end smoke (1-2 prompts) — run in parallel on hosted runners for PRs, keep heavy/long evals on buildkite/nightly
lina: makes sense. would reduce noise and offload short checks to GH hosted. how do we ensure parity with the full eval metric defs though?
ben: we can pick a minimal metric set: generation coherence (BLEU-lite), token-time, and a calibrated quality score (float) — threshold delta = 0.02 for gating
sam: also: ensure the smoke job uses the same quantization build/pipeline artifact. use artifact tag `quant-smoke-${{ github.sha }}`
jt: we should also add retry logic on the cache download: 3 attempts with exponential backoff. current runner gives up immediately
maya: here's a draft GH Action snippet — keep it small:

```yaml
name: eval-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: restore quant artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: quant-smoke-${{ github.sha }}
      - name: run smoke eval
        run: |
          ./scripts/run_eval.sh --model-path ./artifacts/quant --prompts 2 --metrics minimal
```

lina: minor: use `actions/cache` for pip/cache layers too, and add a short timeout so GH jobs don't block CI for >20m
ben: can we gate the full PR on both smoke passing + buildkite quick check? Or make smoke an early guard only
sam: I'd prefer smoke as a hard gate and full eval as a required job that can be allowed to fail-with-warn (so we don't block if e.g., nightly infra is down)
jt: agree, set full eval to `required: false` on GH side and let buildkite enforce final acceptance on merges
maya: CI wiring question: how do we signal failures from smoke back to redwood-evals reporting dashboard? We want the same artifact format and a small JSON with metrics
sam: add an artifacts step that uploads `smoke_report.json` using `actions/upload-artifact`, include fields: model, sha, metrics:{accuracy, latency, token_count}
maya: perfect. then the dashboard can ingest GH artifact via a short lambda or via buildkite bridge
ci-bot: automated note: created issue #4578 to track `eval-smoke` GH Action + runner retry + artifact schema
ben: operational note: when we ran q8 smoke in staging last week, artifact size was ~12MB, upload time ~5s on GH hosted, so should be cheap
lina: watch out for secret access — hosted runners won't have VPC access. quant artifacts must be public or stored in GH artifacts namespace
jt: for private artifacts we can sign them and upload; smoke job just downloads signed artifact and verifies signature
maya: next steps
maya: 1) sam to open PR with action workflow + small script wrapper
maya: 2) jt to add retry wrapper + cache tweaks on runners
maya: 3) ben to post artifact schema and dashboard ingestion stub
maya: 4) lina to verify secrets/VPC constraints for hosted runners
sam: will start the PR today, link here when ready :+1:
jt: I'll add the retry util and test against our self-hosted pool
ben: I'll push the JSON schema to `infra/evals/schemas` and wire a test ingest job
lina: I'll validate access modes and propose fallback (signed artifact) if VPC not available
maya: thanks all — hoping this reduces PR noise and speeds model onboarding
sam: :eyes: will follow up with timing estimates later
ci-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled run queued for `eval-smoke` test suite on staging runners (ETA 12:30)
maya: great, let's regroup tomorrow if we still see flaps
